baseline_forgery_case.security_interpretation: provenance gap if witness input or storage is adversary-modifiable

known_open_boundary.meaning: A separate evidence provider can mutate state just after returning a valid snapshot. The local database transaction cannot make a remote provider or external side effect atomic.
known_open_boundary.required_next_defense: provider-side conditional lease/transaction/version precondition and a durable idempotent effect broker

limits: This test mirrors acceptance-relevant upstream semantics from the inspected source; it does not import or execute the upstream package.
The issue depends on the threat model: if only a trusted in-process caller can supply witness objects and no untrusted persistence boundary exists, external forgery is not established.
The candidate verifier is illustrative, in-memory, and is not production ready. The action effect and nonce consumption are not transactionally coupled to a remote provider.
The admission receipt digest in current finality is carried as metadata but finalize does not verify it corresponds to an issued receipt.
The defended prototype uses a ToyRuntime contract; it is not wired to Lycheetah AssuranceRuntime.
SQLite ledger and HMAC key are assumed to be inside the trusted service boundary.
No production remote side effect was executed.
source_scope: source-equivalent baseline semantics and standalone defensive reference; not full upstream package execution
title: Lycheetah admission witness provenance: baseline vs defended reference prototype
